recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. No further FHIR core work is needed for this seed unless OO opens a new issue changing modern Observation.component semantics or explicitly requests cleanup of historical, unreferenced terminology artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-7517 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Observation request to remove the old has-component related-type code, restore Observation.component as a complex inline element with code, value[x], dataAbsentReason, and referenceRange, and add an invariant about component code matching the parent Observation.code.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit 348f096acfd2c65b60b6ba759f214f756d403709 explicitly applied #7517 by reintroducing Observation.component and moving examples away from has-component related relationships. Current source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml contains the restored component structure, and source/fhir.ini lists observation=Observation as an active resource.
additional_context: FHIR-38955 later published the current obs-7 wording for matching Observation.component.code and Observation.code, so the invariant no longer needs to be reverted to the older literal prohibition. FHIR-7639, which points back to FHIR-7517 for the has-component decision, is already represented on the combined branch by a source-changing commit that fixed stale active _filter examples. FHIR-10118 later replaced generic Observation.related patterns with direct elements such as Observation.hasMember and Observation.derivedFrom.
reconciliation: No source change was made for FHIR-7517. The current combined branch has Observation.component with the requested child structure and guidance, the later accepted obs-7 text, and no remaining active non-generated has-component or old Observation: related[type references found under source.

related_jiras.note: Published issue asking whether ObservationRelationshipType should keep separate has component and has member codes; its resolution points to FHIR-7517 and it is already represented on the combined branch.
Published R5 technical correction establishing the current obs-7 wording for component.code matching Observation.code; already represented on the combined branch.
Later Observation relationship refactor replacing generic Observation.related patterns with direct elements such as Observation.hasMember and Observation.derivedFrom.
